In this training session, you will have to destroy a new type of ship, a Corvette. This Corvette, however, is a weakened version, similar to the previous ships you have faced. It is still more dangerous than the others, though. The Corvette has Proton Turrets, which are more powerful and dangerous than Lasers or Laser Turrets. It also is equipped with Heavy Rockets, Missiles, and Javelin Rockets. Make sure you have restocked your ship with weapons. Destroy the Corvette and return to ConEx. Good luck.
